name: werkzeug-ef518e42-blind20-v6-ots
instr:
# Werkzeug: diagnosing twenty behavioural regressions without a test suite

A program built on this library reads what a client sends, works out what should handle it,
and builds what goes back, and it now gets all three wrong in a number of places. Nothing
about the protocol changed and nothing about the calling code changed. The repository has
received 20 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I have been able to
observe from the outside.

Reading what a client sends. A header value whose parameter is written in the extended,
character-set-tagged spelling — a character set named ahead of a percent-escaped value,
including the continued multi-segment form — comes back with no decoded value for that
parameter, while parameters written plainly or in quotes are still read correctly. Working
out which host a client asked for raises a failure, where it used to hand back an empty
string, when there is neither a host header nor any server information to fall back on.
Asking a mapping that keeps several values per key to seed a key with a starting list no
longer stores what it was given: an empty list comes back, a later list lookup for that key
is empty, and indexing the key complains the key is missing. Submitted fields therefore
vanish — url-encoded fields posted and read back yield nothing, a multi-valued field
submits nothing, fields sent with a DELETE arrive empty, fields carried across a redirect
